messages.text: Hi Li Jing, urgent - found a strategic misalignment in the social sharing PRD. Can we talk?
Sure, what's up? Review is tomorrow morning...

The PRD Section 3 proposes social sharing as primary user acquisition channel. But our Q1 OKR (see OBSN-10) explicitly focuses on RETENTION of existing users, not new acquisition. Social/viral features are deferred to Q2.
Impact: If we build acquisition-focused social sharing now, it won't move our Q1 KPIs (Day-7 retention target 25%, repeat purchase 40%). We'd be off-strategy and waste sprint capacity.

Suggestion: Either 1) Reframe social sharing as retention tool (e.g. share purchase history with friends to get rewards - keeps existing users engaged), or 2) Push entire feature to Q2 when acquisition is priority. Need to revise PRD before tomorrow's review.
Oh wow, you're right. I was thinking acquisition because boss mentioned 'growth' but didn't check the OKR doc. This is a big miss.
Option 1 makes more sense - we can pivot the user flow to retention-focused sharing. I'll update wireframes tonight.
Perfect. I'll update PRD sections 4-5 with retention framing. Let's sync at 9am tomorrow before the review to align.
Got it, will revise the user flow section tonight. Thanks for catching this!
Hey Wang Lei, heads up - we're pivoting the social sharing feature from acquisition to retention focus. Will explain in tomorrow's review.
OK, does that change the technical scope much?
Probably simpler - less external channel integration, more in-app engagement hooks. We'll review details tomorrow.
